capabilities: render YAML code blocks as HTML tables
update tables in real time while editing YAML
add captions via the code block language identifier
configure the code block language that triggers rendering
scroll wide tables horizontally within the note
disambiguation: Not a Markdown table editor; it only renders YAML code blocks as tables for viewing.
problem: Obsidian shows YAML data as raw code, and there is no built-in way to visualize YAML structures as readable tables.
summary: Code block renderer that transforms YAML code blocks into HTML tables with real-time preview while editing.
